lines: Hard Rock (Florida) prices only: player rebounds, points, assists and 3-pointers made, the main line, over or under. No leg worse than -200.

The rule: Pinnacle (the sharpest book) moves its odds on a line by 2+ points of chance between two of our price checks, while the other books on that same line move less than 2 points that way, AND Hard Rock's price is at or better than Pinnacle's fair price (Pinnacle's new chance with its own margin taken out). We bet the side Pinnacle moved toward, at Hard Rock's price.
Prices are checked about 90, 45 and 20 minutes before each tip (plus a morning look). A pick can come from the 90, 45 or 20 minute check. The price shown is frozen and is the one graded.
This is a signal, not a price gap: Hard Rock's price is not always better than Pinnacle's new number. It is being proven on the Record (started 2026-10-28; judged at about 150 bets).
A player listed Out or Doubtful is never picked. Questionable or game-time decision waits until he is cleared or confirmed starting. Needs 10+ games of history.
Early = injury news still open. Injury report clear = he and his team's main rotation are cleared. Starters confirmed = both teams' starting fives are posted.
A pick is pulled if he is ruled out or doubtful, or Hard Rock takes the line down. Pulled picks stay on the Record.
One pick per player per market a night. No cap per game or per night. No parlays.
Graded after the game at the shown price, 1 unit flat. Overtime counts. Did not play = void.
Behind the scenes (Backstage tab, not the Record or Discord): Pinnacle as the price judge, Hard Rock 2%+ better than Pinnacle's price on the same line.
New picks stop by themselves if the Record falls to -10 units.
